brief: Black background, gold writing and a stylised weight symbol with the units inside.

spec.prompt:
Design a matched pair of original ROUND EDITION STICKERS for a practical gardening reference book, The Vegetable Guru. Exactly TWO separate circular stickers side by side, identical size and design, ample transparent space around and between them. Landscape canvas about 2:1. Everything OUTSIDE the two circular stickers must be genuinely transparent; inside each sticker the background is opaque matte near-black #171916. Show only these two stickers, no presentation headings, no book cover, no props, no surrounding words. Both completely visible, not clipped, perfectly circular, flat front-facing artwork, no perspective or curl.

Style: an appealing British seed-merchant / old-fashioned grocer's weights-and-measures graphic, clean and contemporary enough for a friendly gardening book. Black paper with warm muted GOLD lettering and gold linework, approximately #D7B66A. A clear strong silhouette, confident restrained design, excellent small-size readability. Gold looks like flat printed ochre-gold ink, not shiny chrome, yellow neon, reflective jewellery or a 3D medal. No photorealistic metal, embossing, bevels, glitter, fancy flourishes, laurel wreaths, stars, crowns, flags, certification language or seals of approval. A narrow gold perimeter ring and a quiet thin second inset line can frame the composition. Avoid excessive rings and clutter. Typography is friendly bold rounded sans / softly rounded block lettering, balanced and robust rather than formal luxury serif or script. All letterforms readable.

LEFT STICKER: exact heading 'TRADITIONAL', gently following the upper arc. Exact footer 'MEASUREMENTS', gently following the lower arc. These words are GOLD on BLACK. Use generous breathing space so the lettering does not touch any ring or central drawing. Centre a large stylised OUTLINE OF AN OLD GROCER'S SCALE WEIGHT: broad squat trapezoid body with slightly rounded corners, shoulders narrower at top and a small distinctive short neck and loop handle at top. It should look like an old shop calibration weight, not a gym kettlebell or a shopping bag. Use one confident medium-weight gold outline. The body of the weight remains BLACK, matching the sticker. INSIDE that weight body, centre two large, bold gold text lines exactly:
'lb · oz'
'ft · in'
The units must be conspicuous and easily read; the weight icon is a frame for them. These are unit abbreviations, not quantities. Lowercase lb, oz, ft, in. Do not add a number or change spelling.

RIGHT STICKER: exact heading 'METRIC', gently following the upper arc, same cap height as TRADITIONAL on the left, not blown up to fill the shorter word. Exact footer 'MEASUREMENTS', following the lower arc, same font and size as left. IDENTICAL gold-outlined scale-weight drawing and dimensions, same loop handle, identical black-and-gold treatment. INSIDE its weight, centre two large bold gold lines exactly:
'kg · g'
'm · cm'
Same type size and baseline positions as the corresponding left units. Lowercase kg, g, m, cm. Only the heading and four units differ between the two stickers.

Composition must feel charming and practical, with a recognisable classic weight emblem and clear edition identification, not a formal award. The unit words and the symbol should remain legible when a sticker is roughly 4–5 cm across. Keep the black circles generous and the unit typography strong. No white rectangle, no cream sheet behind the stickers. No mention of IMPERIAL, US, ORGANIC, EDITION or The Vegetable Guru inside either sticker. This is a standalone pair of concept assets, not applied to a cover.

review: Correct Traditional/Metric and Measurements wording; lowercase unit symbols match the intended pair.
Large outlined old-style scale weight frames two lines of units; black fields and warm gold lettering.
No cover placement or production export; no new cover number assigned.
scope_note: John believes the book contains no fluid measures. This is recorded as his understanding, not a completed content audit.
